topic: Safety precautions while working on Embedded System
syllabus_extract: Safety precautions while working on Embedded System
specific_objectives: 26.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of ESD wrist strap usage and static-free workspace setup; Instructor supervision of tool handling and grounding verification.
intro_questions: Why is static electricity dangerous to electronics?
List three general safety rules for electrical work.

topics: ESD protection methods and wrist straps
development.content:
Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) hazards
ESD protection methods and wrist straps
Safe handling of sensitive components
Workspace grounding requirements
Proper tool usage and storage

Power supply safety and isolation
Thermal management and ventilation
Emergency shutdown procedures
Cable management and strain relief
Personal protective equipment (PPE) usage

Software safety and data integrity
Backup procedures before maintenance
Secure coding practices
Version control management
Incident reporting protocols

summary_questions: Explain the primary cause of damage to embedded systems during handling.
Describe the correct procedure for grounding yourself before touching a circuit board.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the specific safety protocols required for the Altimeter system discussed in LP 09, highlighting any unique ESD risks compared to general embedded systems.

pft_rows.syllabus: Purpose and function of Altimeter and their types. Global positioning system (GPS) introduction, purpose airborne and space components of the system. Safety precautions to be observed whilst working on avionics systems
